sloka: आपृच्छे त्वाम् पुरीश्रेष्ठे काकुत्स्थपरिपालिते ।दैवतानि च यानि त्वाम् पालयन्त्यावसन्ति च ॥२-५०-२॥
transliteration: āpṛcche tvām purīśreṣṭhe kākutsthaparipālite ।daivatāni ca yāni tvām pālayantyāvasanti ca ॥2-50-2॥

translations.english: O Ayodhya, the best of cities ruled by those born in the Kakutstha race I take leave of you and of all those gods inhabiting and guarding you.
